mode: v3 (idle rotations + move/attack/hit/death, all custom v3)

move.action_description: shuffling forward at a menacing pace, ragged robe swaying, bone trophy skull swinging on its chain

attack.action_description: raising the clawed hand and skull trophy overhead then thrusting it forward to unleash a dark summoning curse, purple-green necrotic energy flaring around the skull

hit.action_description: flinching backward in pain from a hit, recoiling with a pained snarl, bones rattling

death.action_description: collapsing and dying, crumbling to the ground as the skull trophy drops from its grip and bones scatter

notes: First FAN-2519 explicit-eight-direction pack for standard_monster/bone_caller (FAN-2613). 8 idle rotations + 8x6 move/attack/death frames + 8x4 hit frames, all normalized to 245px visible height on a transparent 512x512 canvas, footline pinned at bottom_padding=32. No hover state (bone_caller is ground-based, not flying). Replaces the single west-facing flip-mirrored bone_caller pack.
